name: Cá cháy
summary: Cá cháy is its own plate in the daily rice. The Hội An World Heritage centre’s 16 September 2025 study lists it beside fried fish and before grilled dried fish, and does not describe the fire. Little spice is the rule it gives for these plates. No stall price was printed.
origin: Cham Islands. The daily catch on Tân Hiệp, eaten with rice.
howToEat: With rice, at the midday or evening meal. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal about 17:00–18:00 on the 16 September 2025 study.
The study prints the name and no method. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Bai Lang and the other hamlets. The study names no shop.
seoTitle: Cá cháy — a daily fish plate, Cham Islands
seoDescription: Cá cháy is a daily fish plate on Tân Hiệp, named apart from fried fish. The study prints no method. A stall price is Check on arrival.
